summary:
Donald Trump threatened to annihilate Iran in his speech to the United Nations, but the day also brought a three-hour meeting between US and Iranian officials. Trump called the talks “very good” and said he believed a deal could be reached after the US midterm elections. Iran’s armed forces dismissed his remarks as propaganda.

Typhoon Dujuan brought record rain, landslides and power outages to Japan, killing at least four people. More than 74,000 people in the Tokyo region remained under evacuation orders as authorities warned of further landslides and floods. In a separate diplomatic effort, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said his country was ready to stop strikes on Russian energy facilities if Moscow halted attacks on Ukraine’s energy system. He raised the proposal after meeting Trump at the United Nations General Assembly.

The United States and Denmark signed a defence deal allowing the US to build two military bases in Greenland, while reaffirming Danish sovereignty over the semiautonomous territory. In Sri Lanka, a court convicted 15 men over the 2019 Easter bombings, which killed 279 people, and sentenced them to at least 200 years in prison each. In South Africa, three gunmen killed 11 people and wounded three at a house party in KwaMakhutha; police said the motive was not immediately clear.

headlines.title: Trump threatens Iran as US and Iranian officials meet
headlines.summary: Donald Trump threatened to annihilate Iran in his United Nations speech, while US and Iranian officials held talks on the sidelines. Trump described the three-hour meeting as “very good” and said he believed a deal could be reached after the US midterm elections.

headlines.title: Typhoon kills at least four in Japan
headlines.summary: Typhoon Dujuan brought record rain, landslides and power outages to Japan, killing at least four people. More than 74,000 people in the Tokyo region remained under evacuation orders as authorities warned of further landslides and floods.

headlines.title: Zelensky says Ukraine is ready for an energy truce
headlines.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine would stop striking Russian energy facilities if Moscow halted attacks on Ukraine’s energy system. He raised the proposal after meeting Donald Trump at the United Nations General Assembly.

headlines.title: US and Denmark agree on new military bases in Greenland
headlines.summary: The United States and Denmark signed a defence deal allowing the US to build two military bases in Greenland. The agreement also reaffirms Danish sovereignty over the semiautonomous Arctic territory.

headlines.title: Sri Lanka sentences 15 men over Easter bombings
headlines.summary: A Sri Lankan court convicted 15 men over the 2019 Easter bombings, which killed 279 people. The men received prison sentences of at least 200 years each after a lengthy trial.

headlines.title: Eleven killed in shooting at South African house party
headlines.summary: Three gunmen killed 11 people and wounded three others at a house party in KwaMakhutha, near Durban. Police said one of those killed was believed to be pregnant; the motive was not immediately clear.

headlines.title: EU removes two Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
headlines.summary: The European Union removed Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman from its sanctions list. Ukraine condemned the exemptions, saying they sent Moscow the wrong signal.
